content:
Jordan (support): heads up — escalating Petra Labs (trial) at ~10:05 UTC. Multiple customers hitting severe generation latency (20s+) and occasional 502s. Web app user flows blocked, reported churn risk. CS assistance + customer comms requested.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-7892 — latency spike affecting region-us-west2. Pager notified.
Maria (csm): ack - I can join a call in 10. What data do you have so I can draft a message for Petra? cc @Sasha @Liam
Sasha (support-eng): quick snapshot from the proxy logs:
```
[10:06:12] req_id=7f9a path=/v1/generate status=502 backend=vm-23 latency=20345ms
[10:06:15] req_id=7f9b path=/v1/generate status=200 backend=vm-19 latency=20512ms
```
We also see their traffic pattern: many short sessions + streaming enabled. Could be KV cache thrash + autoscaler slow to react.
Liam (sre): confirmed elevated queue depth on the dedicated pool serving petra-prod: autoscaler still scaling, but GPU init latency + model load is the hold up. I'm going to route new traffic to fallback pool and bump burst capacity. ETA ~18 mins.
Jordan (support): Petra's CSM (external) just pinged support: "users are seeing errors during demo, trial could be cancelled if not fixed quickly." They asked for timeline and any interim workaround we can offer.
Maria (csm): OK — propose comms: short & transparent. Draft below, please edit:
"Hi Petra team — we've detected intermittent latency affecting your trial environment this morning. Our engineers are actively routing traffic to an alternate pool and expect full mitigation in ~30 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem and a one-time trial credit for the impacted sessions. Apologies for the disruption — Maria, Redwood CSM."
Sasha (support-eng): LGTM. Add: recommend temporary toggle to disable streaming for Petra's account (reduces backend concurrency). If we can flip it, UX will be slower but stable.
Liam (sre): done: routed traffic and increased burst. Autoscaler logs:
```
action=route fallback_pool region=us-west2 time=10:14
action=scale pool=dedicated-petra desired=8 actual=3 time=10:15
```
Initial metrics: p50 now 480ms, p95 ~1.8s. Monitoring alert will clear if stable for 5m.
Maria (csm): great. Jordan — can you send the edited comms to Petra and offer a 2-week trial extension + $500 credit? Also ask if they'd like a short status call. I'll join.
Jordan (support): sending now. Copy of outbound text I just posted to Petra slack DM: "Thanks for flagging — our team routed traffic to a fallback pool and you're seeing improved latency. We're keeping a close watch and will extend your trial + credit for the inconvenience. Would you like a 15m call now or later today?"
ops-bot: ALERT cleared for INC-7892 (latency reduced).
Sasha (support-eng): leaving a follow-up checklist for postmortem / CS notes:
- collect request traces for 10:00–10:20 UTC
- config: streaming toggle state + who flipped it
- autoscaler logs + model load times
- customer-visible timeline + credit confirmation
Maria (csm): thanks. I'll log this in the account health doc and add renewal watch for Petra Labs. Assigning owner: Maria. Next steps: postmortem + follow-up email template ready by EOD.
Liam (sre): I'll attach the autoscaler timeline to the incident and share proposed mitigations (improve warm pool, preload common models).
Jordan (support): Petra replied: "Appreciate the quick response, latency much better now. We'll take the call at 2pm PT."
Maria (csm): perfect — I'll coordinate the 2pm PT runbook and invite SRE + Support Eng. :thumbsup:
Sasha (support-eng): adding a short runbook snippet here for the call:
1) Quick intro (CS)
2) Timeline of incident (SRE)
3) Temporary measures taken (Support Eng)
4) Proposed long-term fixes + rollout plan (SRE)
5) Customer questions + next steps
Jordan (support): thanks everyone. Closing thread for now, continuing in the calendar invite.
Maria (csm): closing — will update account health and renewal notes after the follow-up.
